audience: resellers that buy from wholesale suppliers through Feed API

useCases.title: Find wholesale products low on stock
useCases.text: List the active products with their variants and stock quantities. Read the variants of one product for a stock refresh.

useCases.title: Track an order and its shipments
useCases.text: Find the order by your own reference. Then list its shipments and its status history.

useCases.title: Check which suppliers can take orders
useCases.text: List the suppliers. Each one shows whether it can accept orders now.

useCases.title: Review returns and cancellations
useCases.text: List the returns and the item cancellations of one order.
